title: Personal Credit Cards: secured card graduation and tier changes at the cardholder's request
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: secured graduation and tier changes

This policy covers the movement of an existing Personal Credit Cards account from one card tier to another: the graduation of a Secured Visa, and tier changes requested by the cardholder. A tier change keeps the account's history and balance.

## Policy clauses

1. A secured card is reviewed at the tier's graduation review month after opening.
2. It graduates into the tier's graduation tier when the last six statements were all paid on time.
3. On graduation the security deposit is returned to a PCB account of the customer or by official check, and the credit limit is kept.
4. Other tier changes at the cardholder's request are allowed between tiers of the same rewards program only, never into or out of Secured Visa.
5. Such a tier change keeps the limit, the APR and the balance.

## How "paid on time" is counted for graduation

Statements are counted backward, most recent first. A statement counts as paid on time when the payments and credits posted from its closing date through its due date totalled at least that statement's minimum payment due. The count stops at the first statement that fails. Graduation requires that this count covers the last six statements.

## Decision table

| Request | Allowed | What stays the same |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa graduating at its review, last six statements paid on time | yes, into the graduation tier | the credit limit; the deposit is returned |
| Cardholder asks to move between two tiers with the same rewards program | yes | limit, APR and balance |
| Cardholder asks to move between tiers with different rewards programs | no | not applicable |
| Cardholder asks to move into or out of Secured Visa by a tier change | no | not applicable |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical histories)

- A Secured Visa whose last six statements were each covered by payments and credits of at least the minimum due by the due date meets the graduation test at its review.
- A Secured Visa whose third most recent statement fell short of its minimum due by the due date has a count of 2, so the last six are not all on time and it does not graduate at that review.

**Q: Where does the returned deposit go?**
A: To a PCB account of the customer, or by official check.
